title: Connected explicit path with SendUnitData
purpose: Add coverage for the separate SendUnitData encapsulation command using the documented Connected Address Item plus Connected Data Item CPF combination and a small connected payload.
expected_behavior: The implementation should accept the SendUnitData header, parse the connected CPF item combination, and hand the small connected data item to subsequent handling.
constraints_preserved: Encapsulation length is 0x0018 and matches 24 bytes of command-specific data.
SendUnitData uses a 4-byte interface handle and 2-byte timeout before CPF.
First CPF item is Connected Address Item 0x0100 with length 4 and a 4-byte address payload.
Second CPF item is Connected Data Item 0x00b1 with length 2 and a 2-byte data payload.
The documented common SendUnitData item combination is preserved.
issue_safety_notes: This is a conservative connected-path seed and avoids inventing larger connected transport structures.
